article.title: Sleep on it
article.excerpt: A good night’s sleep can help you think better and solve problems more effectively. German scientists say they have demonstrated for the first time that our sleeping brains continue working on problems that baffle us during the day, and the right answer may come more easily after eight hours of rest.
